query: INSERT INTO social_media_category_settings (streamer_login, category_key, auto_post, updated_by) SELECT $1, k.category_key, (k.category_key = $2), 'auto_default' FROM social_media_category k WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM twitch_streamers WHERE twitch_login = $1) ON CONFLICT (streamer_login, category_key) DO NOTHING
